title: Recurring worker consumer loss causes processing backlog
customer_impact: Background ticket processing is delayed; core ticket submission remains available.
scope: Same worker-consumer failure signature as INC-1002; queue grows while consumer count is zero.

timeline.event: L2 acknowledged and correlated the signature with INC-1002.
Approved worker recovery runbook restored the consumer.
Queue drained and synthetic customer journey recovered.
Recurring pattern promoted to PRB-1001 instead of treating this as an isolated incident.

evidence: same worker disconnect signature as INC-1002
resolution: Service restored using existing runbook; recurring cause transferred to problem management.
